name: Battista
source:
He isn’t a human but Bali’s virtual butler of his Oui console. Bali loves maltreating him as a relief valve, but Battista still remains faithful to him and he’s always concerned about his well-being. He can surf into internet, tell the television news, call the police or any other service, blush and have some light virtual sex…the only thing he cannot do is preparing a meal.
He’s someone Bali can always rely on, his only friend.
